snippet.title: Infinity Nikki Version 2.0 PV | Terra's Call
snippet.description:
Infinity Nikki Version 2.0 PV | Terra's Call

The snail shell holds the earliest traces of civilization, 
while the Titans sealed away the secrets of the gods. 
Until a girl's footsteps softly fall, 
uncovering long-buried truths that resonate through earth and wind. 
A whispered prayer is heard as a decree long delayed unfolds in its final chapter…

Infinity Nikki Version 2.0 "Terra's Call" launches on November 25 (UTC-7)!
Dive into the new main story, "Terra's Call," and explore new areas like Spira and Elderwood Forest. Take on three new dungeons and unlock exciting new abilities for your adventure. Plus, don't miss out on the special Nikki's Birthday Celebration events!

In Version 2.0, earn rewards worth up to 126 draws, 15 sets of new clothes, and an entire house for your Home —totally free! See you in Itzaland!

—— 
➤ Infinity Nikki Version 2.0 Terra's Call launches globally on November 25 (UTC-7)!
